g.text: Coverage and surface quality along the same executed routes
40 fixed offline checkpoints · 8 original trajectories · identical TSDF and surface evaluator · no new policy runs
Markers are actual remeasured checkpoints; connecting segments are visual guides. Intermediate scores do not imply terminal qualification.
Both t=18 and t=42 reproduce the original saved maps, canonical surface geometry and numerical scores within the declared tolerance.
